start2.title: Story
start2.text:
You were born and raised in a settlement built around a conquered ant hill. Most residents here are hunters and craftsmen, and they feed themselves by hunting monsters, as farming techniques have long been lost here.

You, having neither the courage to hunt nor the skills to craft, have become a scout.

start3.title: Story
start3.text:
Every day, you wake up early in the morning and patrol the nearby area to notify the settlement of any dangers or things to scavenge.

This is a dangerous job. Many scouts disappear without a trace every week. Like any scout, you must carry a weapon around at all times, even if you don't have the courage to fight. Your weapon of choice was...

startrange.title: Story
startrange.text:
You carry around a ranged weapon in case there is something weak that you can hunt from outside danger's reach.

Your ranged weapon of choice was...

startmelee.title: Story
startmelee.text:
You carry around a melee weapon to prepare for the worst case scenario of being ambushed by one of the many dangerous predators near the hill.

Your melee weapon of choice was...

ant hill.title: Ant Hill
ant hill.text:
You are standing on the slanted streets of Ant Hill.

The streets are crowded with people walking around trying to buy meat from the hunter shops.
Near the top of the hill you see the barred entrance to the underground where people take shelter during the night.

ant hill underground.title: Ant Hill Underground
ant hill underground.text:
You open the barred gate and enter the underground section of the settlement.

It is mostly dark, and the only light sources here are from green glowshrooms planted along the hallways and domesticated fireflies that people herd around.
You walk through the familiar dirt mazes.

ant hill home.title: Home
ant hill home.text:
You arrive at your dormitory. Your roommates greet you.

You sit on your hammock and make a conversation with your roommates about hunting ants.

You hear people shouting and running in the halls.
It sounds like there is something going on outside on the surface...

ant hill ambushed.title: Ant Hill
ant hill ambushed.text:
You run outside to see the streets raided by the infamous horned spiders.
You see people getting kidnapped and dragged away.

Your roommates cower back inside.
There are hunters with weapons beside you, but they just guard the entrance, not daring to go out to the streets to help the people.

You see a girl getting dragged off by a horned spider, screaming.

opt.text: Run back inside. The spiders are as big as you are.

ant hill ambushed skip.title: Home
ant hill ambushed skip.text:
It's probably nothing... Even if it was, you'll hear it from someone else later.
You lay down on your hammock and rest while all your roommates leave to find out what's going on.
You fall asleep.

ant hill aftermath.title: Home
ant hill aftermath.text:
It's %time.

The bustling movements and tension in the air fades.
You hear that about 7 people were kidnapped away by the dreaded horned spiders earlier today.

ant hill kidnapped 2.text:
...

You hear a stranger's voice.

Stranger: [Hey, wake up!]

You open your eyes but don't see anything.
It is pitch black.

Stranger: [We have to get out of here, get up.]

Suddenly, you are blinded by a streak of light.
You turn your head to protect your eyes.
You glimpse back at it and realize that it is a faint blue light cast with magic! You look at the spellcasting stranger with envy.

Spellcaster: [My name is Lucid. We've been kidnapped by the horned spiders a few hours ago. There are eight of us and we're going to make a run for it.]

spider death.text: You fall back asleep while the other abductees make a run for it. Hours passed, and one of the hungry spiders kill and eat you while you are asleep.

opt.text: I made the wrong choice, I guess...

runaway.title: Kidnapped
runaway.text:
You follow Lucid through the tunnels.
The underground tunnel you are in feels similar to the underground Ant Hill, except the tunnels are larger and there are spiderweb cocoons on the walls.

You and the abductees keep running until you reach the exit blocked by leaves and spiderwebs.
There are lights leaking in from the outside.

Lucid: [That's the way out. This underground tunnel seems like their food storage area, which means there is a good chance that some of the spiders are nearby.]

Lucid: [You are a scout, right? Can you go outside and scout ahead for us?]

runaway1-1.title: Kidnapped
runaway1-1.text:
Lucid: [...Fine. If you hear a sound, please come out and help me.]

Lucid takes out his knife.
He slashes through the spiderwebs and crawls outside.
You hear one of the other abductees behind you call you a coward.

A minute passed, and you hear Lucid scream from outside.

runaway2.title: Kidnapped
runaway2.text:
You crawl outside and look around the forest.
In the distance, you see people in rags wielding weapons.
You don't recognize any of them.
You crawl back inside and tell everyone.

Lucid: [We should wait for them to pass then sneak out.]

Abductee: [Are you sure they're not people from Ant Hill? We gotta get out there and let them know we're here!]

Lucid: [But these people wear rags and wander the spider forest fearlessly. Something's not right.]

Abductee: [You may not understand because you're foreigner, but Ant Hill don't have brigands or outlaws... Those people out there are safe. Follow me.]

runaway2-2.title: Kidnapped
runaway2-2.text:
You follow the abductee outside.

Abductee: [Hey, over here!]

The people in rags start throwing rocks at him.

Abductee: [Oh, shit!]

Lucid: [Get ready to fight!]

runaway1-2.title: Kidnapped
runaway1-2.text: You and the abductees peek outside and see Lucid being attacked by several people in rags. They point at you and shout.

runaway2-2-1.title: Kidnapped
runaway2-2-1.text:
You take down the feral human and look around.
It looks like all of the ferals have gone down, but 4 people have died as a result.

You inspect the feral humans and notice that they don't look particularly starved. What you thought was their rags actually seem to be some sort of clothing crafted from some leather.

One of the critically wounded feral woman opens her eyes slowly looks up. She stares at you with pleasing eyes and whimpers.

You try to communicate with her but she does not seem to understand you.
The other abductees fret you to just abandon her and leave the spider forest before the horned spiders return.

You leave the dying feral woman and depart with your group.

ant hill outskirt.title: Return to Ant Hill
ant hill outskirt.text:
After much paranoid walking, your group finally arrive at the Ant Hill after about an hour of walk.

People come out to meet and greet. Families of the lost ones grieve. Some thank you for getting out there to try to fight the spiders.

You return to your roommates and share your fascinating stories...

ant hill spellcaster.title: Return to Ant Hill
ant hill spellcaster.text:
You find Lucid talking to the priest in the underground temple.

Lucid: [Ah, it's you. I forgot to thank you for your help back in the woods. Are you doing ok?]

ant hill spellcaster2.title: Return to Ant Hill
ant hill spellcaster2.text:
Lucid: [Of course. The priest wanted me to teach some people in Ant Hill spellcasting. You are welcome to join the session, friend.]

Priest: [I heard what you did out there. It wasn't the brightest decision to try to fight the spiders, but you seem to have brought us good luck in the end. I need some time with Lucid right now, why don't you come back another time?]

You return to your dormitory to rest for the day.

ant hill next week.title: Home
ant hill next week.text:
It's been a week since the kidnapping incident. People went back to their normal lives, as death and disappearances aren't uncommon in Ant Hill.

One of the hunters let you know that the high priest is looking for you.

ant hill temple.title: Ant Hill Temple
ant hill temple.text:
You walk into the underground temple.
There is a blue stone altar in the center surrounded by glowshrooms.
On the bench at the corner of the room you spot Cobby, a veteran hunter of Ant Hill, and Cheese, son of the priest.
The priest dressed in white robe comes out from the back to greet you.

Priest: [Welcome.]

ant hill temple1.title: Ant Hill Temple
ant hill temple1.text:
Priest: [A foreign visitor named Lucid hailing from the city of Jericho is with us right now. He's the spellcaster who escaped the spider nest.]

Lucid: [Hello.]

Priest: [Anyways. As you well know, every month we send a hunter on an arduous journey to Stone Henge. Cobby here has been selected for that honor this month. You will assist him in his journey as his scout.]

Priest: [Also... my son will be accompanying you. I know I may be burdening you with this, but please try your best. Don't prioritize taking care of him. Reaching Stone Henge comes first.]

Cheese: [What are you saying, dad? Why do you always make me look bad?]

Priest: [...Anyways, we will hold a great feast tomorrow to celebrate Lucid's arrival and your departure.]

You see Lucid lost in thought with a worried look on his face.

ant hill temple2.title: Ant Hill Temple
ant hill temple2.text:
Priest: [As you well know, every month we send a hunter on an arduous journey to Stone Henge to keep in touch with them. Cobby here has been selected for that honor this month. You will assist him in his journey as his scout.]

Priest: [Also... my son will accompany you on the trip. I know I may be burdening you with this, but please try your best. Don't prioritize taking care of him. Reaching Stone Henge comes first.]

Cheese: [What are you saying, dad? Why do you always make me look bad?]

Priest: [... Anyways, we will hold a feast for your departure tomorrow so you can say your good byes to your folks. Always remember that you are carrying out one of the most honorable quests for Ant Hill.]
